per_helper_reviews.identity_and_delivery_review: The release-plan loader rechecks the exact frozen independent approvals before this downstream helper proceeds. Content acceptance requires the content-phase report for the exact plan, all 31 distinct expected asset identities and HTTP successes, matching remote/build/workflow commit, the named Pages workflow, and three completed successful jobs. The supplied report path must be the canonical path derived from phase/attempt. The native delivery receipt must have the exact verifier command and root workdir, a successful exit, stable input hashes, intact raw log and started receipt; its logged output report ref must equal the actual supplied report, and both the report helper ref and protected verifier SHA must match current verify_solution_delivery.py. The observation logs are exact SHA-bound files. Fixed content commit/push receipt commands and the publication cwd are checked, followed by actual clean-main HEAD/remote and expected staged-parent identities. Both canonical and publication site bytes must still equal the approved 31-file map.
per_helper_reviews.preservation_and_recovery_review: All six prepared documents and the 556-row tracker are preserved under a separate immutable HISTORY path. Each original is read once, its raw SHA is compared with the documentary/frozen-tracker binding, and those exact verified bytes are published; saved originals are rechecked on every run. Expected new bodies are derived from those originals. The complete preflight, per-destination late-edit guard and final exact-byte check admit only original or selected bytes. Atomic replacements and immutable readiness output allow interruption and identical-input resumption without duplicating appended documentation. Unexpected current edits are refused and preserved.
per_helper_reviews.formal_scope_review: The 556 tracker rows advance only from independently approved/pending adoption to installed/content delivered. The exact approved draft snapshot and installation/delivery references remain recorded; formal_coverage_changed and formal_coverage_promoted remain false. Historical proof/coverage fields are carried forward without modification. Progress and readiness explicitly leave metadata delivery pending. Documentation now uses future tense for the separate metadata commit/check and keeps expanded-answer formal correspondence pending.

per_helper_reviews.identity_and_delivery_review: Both content and metadata phases independently require the exact plan, all 31 expected live asset hashes, Pages build and named successful workflow at the respective commit, all three successful jobs, canonical phase/attempt report path, native command/cwd/raw-output report binding and current protected verifier identity. Four fixed commit/push receipts are checked. Fresh Git observations require metadata HEAD, its immediate parent equal to the content commit, remote main at metadata, a clean checkout and branch main. Canonical/publication site bytes must remain selected. Local release-ready evidence is exact-bound, the selected audit has the required 1,267/11,472 counts and fresh build/axiom status, and publication documentation bytes must match metadata readiness.
per_helper_reviews.preservation_and_recovery_review: The final delivery receipt is immutable; a completed rerun retains its original timestamp/observations only after all current gates pass and all other final fields match. The original metadata-stage progress bytes are read once and SHA-bound to readiness before saving; the saved original SHA is checked on every run. Final local progress accepts only that original or its exact selected closure bytes and is atomically replaced with a final exact-byte check. A local-progress interruption resumes using the existing publication receipt. The closure executes only read-only Git observations and leaves the publication checkout unchanged, avoiding another self-referencing metadata commit.
per_helper_reviews.formal_scope_review: Closure marks actual content and metadata delivery complete only after both phases pass. It explicitly keeps formal_coverage_complete false, rewritten-answer correspondence pending, and client/application crash diagnosis false. The historical Source90 formal counts and scope remain unchanged. Its final progress change is local and is separate from the already delivered metadata commit.

resolved_issues.issue: An arbitrary copied delivery report could be supplied although the bound verifier command only produces its canonical phase/attempt report.
resolved_issues.fix: Canonical filename is required in both helpers; native verifier stdout must also bind the exact supplied report SHA.
resolved_issues.evidence: The exact initial metadata helper accepted the copied alias; the current helper refuses it. Both helpers reject a report whose current SHA differs from the native logged report ref.

resolved_issues.issue: Hashing the current original and rereading it for the immutable backup allowed a late edit to poison HISTORY and obstruct corrected resumption.
resolved_issues.fix: Both helpers now read each original once, verify that raw SHA and save exactly those bytes.
resolved_issues.evidence: The initial helper fixture stored a poisoned original and still refused after the live document was repaired. The revised fixture saved the correct original, refused the unexpected live edit and resumed after repair.

resolved_issues.issue: Closure did not initially require current protected verifier identity and the actual Pages workflow name for both phases.
resolved_issues.fix: Both per-phase closures compare report helper ref and native verifier SHA with the current helper and require pages build and deployment.
resolved_issues.evidence: Closure fixtures reject wrong workflow, changed helper ref and stale protected verifier SHA.

resolved_issues.issue: Closure did not initially recheck an existing saved progress snapshot against the metadata-readiness original binding.
resolved_issues.fix: Every closure run checks the saved original SHA against readiness.
resolved_issues.evidence: A corrupted existing HISTORY snapshot is refused; restoring it allows the identical closure to resume.

resolved_issues.issue: Metadata prose used completed-sounding present tense before the separate metadata commit/check had occurred.
resolved_issues.fix: The paragraph now says publication metadata will be committed and checked separately; pending booleans remain true until closure.
resolved_issues.evidence: The positive metadata fixture verifies future-tense prose, metadata_delivery_claimed false and the pending progress flag.

limits: This is approval of the exact code implementations and isolated failure/recovery behavior, not evidence of actual content or metadata delivery.
All fixture receipts, Git observations and live/Pages responses are synthetic; no actual commit, push, live HTTP request or Pages job was executed.
The previously independently reviewed complete release approval gate is substituted by an exact fixture-plan gate so these tests isolate the new downstream helpers.
Actual native content/metadata receipts, publication identities, all31 live hashes and all3 jobs must pass later before the production helper may claim delivery.
The reviewer changed only test/history/review artifacts; canonical documentation, source pages, helper code and the publication checkout were not changed.
Final progress closure intentionally remains local; it does not claim that those later local progress bytes are already in the delivered metadata commit.
